rules.title: State bar on local rent control (M.G.L. c.40P s.4)
rules.requirement: Cities and towns may not enact, maintain or enforce rent control. A town that accepts c.40P may only adopt voluntary regulation, excluding units of owners with fewer than ten units or fair market rent over $400, with the town compensating owners.
rules.exemptions: Narrow exception for towns accepting c.40P: voluntary compliance after six months, no regulation of occupancy, services, evictions or condo conversion, not units owned by owner of fewer than ten units or with fair market rent above $400, municipality compensates owners
rules.quoted_span: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind
rules.interaction: Preempts local rent control in Boston and Cambridge (cities may not adopt rent control).

notes: Statute text gives no effective date. Not an enacted cap: it bars local caps; Massachusetts has no statewide rent cap in these documents.
